summary: Completed backend testing of the new multi-turn NL parser for conversation-based strategy building. All 12 tests passed. The rewritten parser implements 3 response modes (question/strategy/error), asks follow-up questions for missing info, handles F&O redirect, and supports session finalize + draft edit endpoints.
passed_tests: POST /session/{id}/message with 'I want to trade Reliance' → mode=question, asks about timeframe/indicators
POST /session/{id}/message 'Buy when RSI < 30' without SL → mode=question, asks about stop loss or exit/timeframe
POST /session/{id}/message 'I want to sell Nifty puts' → F&O redirect message (equity-only support message)
Full conversation with complete info returns mode=strategy or mode=question (AI may ask clarifying questions - expected behavior)
POST /session/{id}/finalize without draft → 400 error with 'No strategy draft' message
POST /session/{id}/finalize with draft → saves strategy to strategies collection, returns strategy_id
PUT /session/{id}/draft → updates draft, draft can be finalized after
GET /api/v1/strategies returns finalized strategy with correct schema (name, params, operator fields)
Risk management normalized: stop_loss and take_profit as float values (e.g., 5 → 5.0)
critical_code_review_comments: NL_BUILDER_SYSTEM_PROMPT correctly defines 3 response modes (question/strategy/error) with proper JSON schemas
_normalize_ai_strategy properly transforms AI-generated strategy format to strict Pydantic schema
_validate_strategy_draft checks for required fields (entry_conditions, instrument, timeframe)
Session ownership check in get_session returns 'forbidden' string for cross-user access, properly converted to 403
Finalize endpoint normalizes risk_management with float() conversion for stop_loss/take_profit
seed_data_creation: None - using existing test users testai@example.com and testai2@example.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-turn NL parser fully tested. Key behaviors: 1) Session /message returns JSON with mode field (question/strategy/error). 2) Strategy mode has strategy_draft in response. 3) Finalize saves to strategies collection using _normalize_ai_strategy to transform AI format to strict Pydantic schema. 4) PUT /draft allows manual editing before finalize. 5) AI sometimes asks extra clarifying questions even when all info is provided — this is expected behavior. 6) Rate limit: 10/min on session/start, 20/min on session/message.
